statement: We prove in Theorem 11 that BPI-UCRL enjoys the same sample complexity guarantees than RF-UCRL, both in the small δ and the small ε regime. Yet, as illustrated in the next section, BPI-UCRL appears to perform more efficient exploration than RF-UCRL for a fixed reward function. We leave as an open question whether an improved analysis for BPI-UCRL could corroborate this improvement (besides the slightly smaller constant CH in Theorem 11).
